mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which may potentiate orthostatic hypotension and syncope associated with rasagiline, particularly in combination with other agents.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and blood pressure closely during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation; consider alternative antifungal if possible.
